## variants
SET DEFAULT unsupported
  error UNSUPPORTED "unsupported: ANSI test cannot SET a column to DEFAULT; enter the value explicitly"
insert of defaults only unsupported
  error UNSUPPORTED "unsupported: ANSI test cannot insert a row of defaults only; enter at least one value"
server expression unsupported
  error UNSUPPORTED "unsupported: ANSI test has no currentTimestamp for \"created\""

  sql: "UPDATE \"app\".\"users\" SET \"age\" = ? WHERE rowid = ?"
  params: [{"t":"int","v":1},{"t":"int","v":42}]
  preview: "UPDATE \"app\".\"users\" SET \"age\" = 1 WHERE rowid = 42"
